entities.name: S3
entities.rationale: Green bucket icon labeled S3 (AWS_Icon_6). Receives an incoming arrow from the left (external upload source not drawn) and connects down to Step Functions.

entities.name: Step Functions
entities.rationale: Pink icon labeled STEP FUNCTIONS (AWS_Icon_3). Orchestrator fanning out to MediaConvert, Rekognition, Transcribe and DynamoDB.

entities.name: Elemental MediaConvert
entities.rationale: Orange icon labeled ELEMENTAL MEDIACONVERT (AWS_Icon_7). Target of an arrow from Step Functions.

entities.name: Rekognition
entities.rationale: Teal icon labeled REKOGNITION (AWS_Icon_4). Receives from Step Functions and outputs to DynamoDB.

entities.name: Transcribe
entities.rationale: Teal icon labeled TRANSCRIBE (AWS_Icon_1). Receives from Step Functions, outputs to Comprehend and DynamoDB.

entities.name: Comprehend
entities.rationale: Teal icon labeled COMPREHEND (AWS_Icon_2). Receives from Transcribe and outputs to DynamoDB.

entities.name: DynamoDB
entities.rationale: Purple icon labeled DYNAMODB (AWS_Icon_5). Stores results from Step Functions, Rekognition, Transcribe and Comprehend; arrow goes up to the Reach Engine box.

entities.name: EC2
entities.rationale: Orange icon labeled EC2 (AWS_Icon_9). Drawn inside the green rectangular box labeled REACH ENGINE, together with EKS.

entities.name: EKS
entities.rationale: Orange icon labeled EKS (AWS_Icon_8). Drawn inside the green rectangular box labeled REACH ENGINE, together with EC2.

entities.name: Reach Engine
entities.rationale: Green rectangular container labeled REACH ENGINE that contains the EC2 and EKS icons; represents the Reach Engine application running on EC2/EKS. Receives an arrow from DynamoDB.
